text: Mulching is an important practice in gardening, which aids in retaining soil moisture, preventing weed growth, and creating a visually appealing setting. Composting is also vital as it aids in the decomposition of organic materials, releases nutrients, and produces a nutrient-rich soil amendment. A diverse array of plants and insects can be incorporated into the garden to create a rich and varied ecosystem. To ensure the garden's success, meticulous planning and attention to detail are necessary.
